title: Build a responsive card
summary: Sass can group a screen-size rule with the component it styles.
introduction: Sass can group a screen-size rule with the component it styles. Your task: Change the wider-screen padding and test both sizes.
learningObjectives: Change the wider-screen padding and test both sizes.
Explain the example for build a responsive card

blocks.text: Sass can group a screen-size rule with the component it styles. The output is still a normal CSS media query.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: A media query only applies its enclosed styles when the stated condition matches. The other styles remain the starting rules.

blocks.text: The card has 1rem padding on narrow screens and 2rem when the viewport is at least 40rem wide.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A media query checks the viewport here, not the card width. Test the built CSS at more than one screen size.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the wider-screen padding and test both sizes.
